senses.gloss: योजन n. 1. Junction, yoking; 2. a measure of distance equal to 8 or 9 miles, M.xi.75; 3. application, preparation; 4. construction, putting together of the sense of a passage; 5. instigation, exciting; 6. abstraction, concentration of the mind.
योजना f. 1. Union, connection; 2. grammatical construction.
योजन-गन्धा f. 1. musk; 2. an epithet of Satyavatī.
